Bug Report: Checkout returns 500 when FLASHSALE discount code is applied
Description:
Users report that when applying the FLASHSALE promo code during checkout,
the checkout service crashes with HTTP 500 error.
The payment pipeline fails during checkout processing with paymentTotal becoming null.
Steps to reproduce:
1. Add items to cart with subtotal $100.00.
2. Enter discount promo code 'FLASHSALE'.
3. Click 'Complete Purchase'.
Observed:
Internal Server Error: NullPointerException in PaymentRequestBuilder setAmount.
Expected:
Checkout should succeed with discount applied.
